The studio guide for [`mascot_characters()`](../reference/mascot_characters.html). The same page is read in the mascot studio.

```{r setup, include = FALSE}
guide <- system.file("examples", "studio", "guide", package = "mascot")
sys.source(file.path(guide, "guide-helpers.R"), envir = knitr::knit_global())
```

```{r child = file.path(guide, "mascot_characters.Rmd")}
```
